words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: The car needs a new starter to start the engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车需要一个新的启动器来发动引擎。
words.en: A starter is a person or thing that starts something, especially a device that initiates the operation of an engine or machine.
A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.
used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.
You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.
A bell is a device that makes a ringing sound and is used to give a signal or to attract attention.
